Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of G1497; an image-fane:--idol's temple.
BiblicalUsage: This word is an idol's temple, the place where meat offered to idols was eaten, and Paul uses it once. He warns that if a weak brother sees a man with knowledge sitting at meat in the idol's temple, his conscience will be emboldened to eat what his faith cannot carry. The building is not the problem; the brother watching is.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe my freedom ends where my brother's faith begins, because love, not knowledge, decides what I do in front of him.
